name: Herbed Salmon with Roasted Green Beans & Cauliflower Mash
instructions: Fill a large pot halfway with water and bring to a boil.
Wash green beans and trim ends. Transfer to a sheet pan. Drizzle with oil and season with salt and pepper; toss to coat.
Spread out evenly and place in the oven. Tossing once halfway through, roast until tender-crisp, 10-15 minutes.
Wash and remove leaves from cauliflower; cut into bite-sized florets.
Once water in saucepan is boiling, add cauliflower. Reduce heat to medium, cover, and cook until very tender, 12-15 minutes.
Heat a skillet over medium heat.
Season salmon fillet with salt, pepper, and parsley flakes.
Coat bottom of skillet with oil. Add salmon and cook until opaque, 3-4 minutes per side.
Drain cauliflower and return to saucepan. Add oil, parsley flakes, salt, and pepper. Mash until smooth.
To serve, place cauliflower mash on a plate, add salmon on top, and have green beans on the side. Garnish with lemon wedges. Enjoy!
author: Mealime
